artifact_digest_spec.artifact_files: skills.md plus every regular file under references/, recursively
artifact_digest_spec.canonicalization: entries {"path": <POSIX relpath from the skill directory>, "sha256": <lowercase hex sha256 of the file bytes>} sorted by path; canonical value {"files": [entries]}; canonical bytes json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode(); digest "sha256:" + hexdigest of those bytes
artifact_digest_spec.exclusions: manifest.json (cannot digest itself) and corpus.json (benchmark data, digested separately below)

benchmark_corpus_digest_spec: sha256 over the raw bytes of corpus.json (the exportable public corpus file; blind cases live outside it and are not part of this digest)
negative_exemplars: Certify that an anchored page is factually correct — lexical resolution is not entailment
Anchor claims against a dirty or unpinned checkout
Fetch sources over the network to anchor against
non_capabilities: no semantic-truth guarantee: a lexical anchor pass never establishes that a claim is true, current, or complete
no network fetching: the oracle and the loop read only the local pinned fixture repository
no host qualification: this artifact does not qualify, attest, or admit any execution host
positive_exemplars: Generate a wiki for a pinned repo snapshot and iterate with the anchor oracle until every page passes lexically
Repair a page whose anchor reports quote_not_found by re-copying the quote byte-for-byte from the pinned file
qualification_note: explicit sentinel: no qualification receipt exists yet; the binding is validated at Slice 5
